column1: # config/routing.tsv -- route per instruction-count bucket (T5, Phase 1.8): `tools/wave.py draw` buckets by min/max insns (max - = open); cards carry route/card_cap/attempts. TAB-separated; route in draft|draft+permute|hard; card_cap = max plateau.py compile runs per drafting coder; attempts = coder attempts per target (H7); drafted/banked/rate/cost_ctx_k measured on the manual wave named in basis. T6: cliff = smallest bucket with rate < best/2; wave weight = insns per wave sized to 1000k drafter tokens (one Pro usage window, overhead 0.235 on top); before drawing, sum rate*cost_ctx_k over the --dry-run targets and lower --weight until <= 1000k.

# T6 basis (M1; wave.py --check counts a row measured only when basis is exactly the manual wave id, so the derivation lives here): best rate 0.80 (b1-b4), half = 0.40; b5 0.40 is at half, not below -> draft; CLIFF = b6 (401+ insns, 0.20 < 0.40) -> draft+permute (draft, then permute.py/plateau.py on the residual). Per-route caps from M1: draft and draft+permute card_cap 8 plateau.py runs, 1 coder attempt (M1 ran 1-8 runs; every MATCH came within 5). Wave weight: draft waves 2500 insns, b6 waves 8000 insns, one wave = 1000k drafter tokens (docs/ops/decomp-environment.md Waves, tasks/T6.md).
